entities.summary: Bishop Miguel Mykycej, F.D.P. was a Poland-born Argentine Ukrainian Greek Catholic hierarch. He served as a Titular Bishop of Nazianzus and Auxiliary Bishop of Eparchy of Santa María del Patrocinio en Buenos Aires from 23 June 1990 until 20 January 1998; Apostolic Administrator the same Eparchy from 20 January 1998 until 24 April 1999; and as the Eparchial Bishop of Santa María del Patrocinio en Buenos Aires from 24 April 1999 until his retirement on 10 April 2010.
